book.name: Luka
book.title: Malobhe gha Mbone ngita chighajhandikwe na Luka

content: Litambiko lya mwikeghe nawela
Yecho palolokiya kulingukiya ajhakwammona mundo jwabhii na ilebhe yamahele palekila mbijha mukichukilo chu kubheke litambiko pa Nyumba jha Chapanga.
Helahela ajhakummona majhe jhumo nawela, nhocho ajhakupiya chente ibhele ya mbijha.
Yecho ajhakwalobholela bhabholwa bhake, “Ninnobholela chakaka, nawela jwenio, apihite kuliku bhange.
Nhwalo bhoha bhapihite kubhoka mu majhonjekeko ghabhe, nambo majhe hojho nhocho akung'winde yoha yabhii nako.”
Yecho ilonge chipalwa kutilulwanwa kwa Nyumba jha Chapanga
Bhabholwa bhange bhalongila panane jha Nyumba jha Chapanga, chichengwite kwa maghanga ghambone, helahela bhalongila matambiko ghighapihitwa na bhando kwa Chapanga. Nambo Yecho ajhakulonge,
“Ghanga ghoha ghubhaghabhona, machiko ghabhikuhika, libhiijhe hilu lighanga lilipala kuhighalika panane jha lenge, kila kilebhe nakiyangabhanwa.”
Malagho na lung'ahe
Bhahe, bhando bhajhakunkonya Yecho, “Mmola, naghapitila legha mambu ghanga? Bho, na nginyililo ghane jhipala kulangiya kuhika kwino?”
Yecho ajhakwajhanguu, “Mukilolekeye bhakotoka kunkopokeya. Nhwalo bhamahele nabhahika kwa liina lyango, nabhalongela, ‘Jwenio ndi nenga!’ Na ‘Machiko ghala ghabhandikile!’ Nambo mwangakengama.
Bhahe, pumipala kujhoha malobhe gha ngondo na lihangambwela, mangajhoghopa, nhwalo ilebhe yenio naitumbula kupitila, Nambo kujhomokela kwake kwamela.”
Peniya Yecho pajhendilila kulonge, “Kilambo chimo na akakomana na bhando bha kilambo chenge, na unahota nkolongwa ghumo naukomana na unahota ghonge.
Napapitila mindimilo mikolongwa pannema na njala na malwalo. Naghapitila mambu gha kujhoghopwa na nginyililo ngolongwa kunane kwa Chapanga.

Nambo naghalapiti hote jhe gheniya, nabhankamula na kuung'aha na kupelekangana mu Nyumba jha kukonganikii Akayahude na kutabhangana mukipungo, nabhampeleka palonge jha akanahota na ilongoche, kwa nhwalo gwa liina lyango.
Jhenje ndi pwache jha kwalangiya Lilobhe lya Mbone bheniya.
Nambo nkotoka kubhehe na kiholo ku mwojho nanongela nike kabula jha kukikengelela.
Nhwalo namwete naninpela malobhe gha kulonge na malango. Hilu makoko bhino nabhahotola ndeka kukwima na kukana ghala ghumulongela.
Mangota nanyambilwa na akatate bhino na akalongo bhino na akakoche bhino, na bhange pakate jhino nabhakomwa.
Bhando bhoha nabhanchimwa mangota nhwalo gwa liina lyango.
Nambo, hilu lijhunjo limo lya pamuto gwino nalihobhelela ndeka.
Kwa kuhimbilila kwino namukombola ughome gwino.
Yecho alonge kutilulwana kwa Yeluchalemo
“Pumpala kwabhona akakomana ngondo bhautindile muche gwa ku Yeluchalemo, umanya kubhehe machiko ghabhandikile gha kutilulwana kwake.
Peniya bhando bhubhabhii ku Yudeya bhabhutikila ku kitombe na bhando bhibhabhii pakate jha muche bhatilila panja jha muche na bhando bhibhabhii kunghonda bhakotoka kujhingila ku bomane.
Nhwalo machiko gheniya ndi machiko gha kuhadabulwa, ghoha ghighajhandikwe mu Majhandiko gha Chapanga ghalenganike.
Nakole kiya bhubhii na ndumbo na bhibhajhongecha kwa machiko gheniya! Nhwalo napabhehe na mang'ahiko makolongwa na lilaka lya Chapanga nabhahadabula bhando bheniya.
Bhange nabhakomwa kwa upanga na bhange nabhapukilwa ngita akapungwa na kupechenganwa mu ilambo yoha. Helahela bhando bhangabhehe bhu ku Yeluchalemo nabhalebheta ade lichiko lyabhe pulipala kuhika.
Kuhika kwa Mwana gwa Mundo
“Peniya napabhaha nginyililo mu lyobha na mu mwehe na mu ndondwa. Bhando bha pannema nabhabha na malagho kwa nhwalo gwa bhoghohe ghuletwa kuhumii mu milindimilo jha mbwane na matuhe ghake gha mache.
Bhando nabhahinduka kwa bhoghohe, bhakilola nike chikipala kuukolela nnema, nhwalo ilebhe yoha ya kunane kwa Chapanga nainyukanyuka kwa makakala.
Peniya ndi, nabhamona Mwana gwa Mundo akahuluka mumahunde, na makakala na ulumbililo nkolongwa.
Puhipala kutumbula kupitila ilebhe yenio, nnyemengane na kujhinula mabhonge ghino kunane, nhwalo ughombokeko gwino ubhandikile.”
Mabholo gha nkongo gwa ntine
Peniya Yecho ajhakwalobholela nnandanikiho ghongo, “Mulolekehe nkongo gwa nkojho na mikongo jhenge jhoha.
Putumbula kutundula mahamba, mabhene umanye mahuno ghabhandikile.
Helahela mangota pumipala kubhona ilebhe yenio ikahengeka umanya kubhehe ndi unahota nkolongwa ubhandikile.
“Ninnobholela chakaka, bhando bha kibheluko chenje nabhawe ndeka ade ilebhe yenio ipitile.
Kunane kwa Chapanga na nnema nakupeta, nambo malobhe ghango naghapeta ng'o.
Nkeluwe
“Mme miho! Miojho jhino jhikotoka kukamulwa na kuhapa, kulobhela na kupikiya miho ilebhe ya mukilambo mone. Na lichiko nalihikilila kwa kupwitikilila pwitu ngita ntambo pugwijhonja.
Nhwalo nalyapwitikilila ngita ntambo bhando bhoha bhibhatama kila chehemo jha nnema.
Mukilolekeye na nnyope machiko ghoha na kubhehe likakala lya kujhomboka njelembo kwa mambu gheniya ghoha ghighapala kupitila, na kujhema palonge jha Mwana gwa Mundo.”
Machiko ghoha Yecho akibha mukubhola bhando pa Nyumba jha Chapanga, na kilo ajhahwila ku kitombe chuku Micheitune na kutama kwenio.
Bhando bhoha bhatehila kulabha kujhenda pa Nyumba jha Chapanga kunnyokanikiya Yecho.
